note: The Candela gallery's scenes, in showing order, as [preset id, width and height]: PICOCALC-CANDELA-CPU-KERNEL's six measured scenes, then PICOCALC-CANDELA-SECTIONS' other verified presets by cost. 160 x 160 unless one pass would take more than about 1.6 s on one core (estimated from SECTIONS' host and RV32 costs, its design Section 4); then 80 x 80. The display upscales either to 320 x 320. Not in the gallery: K-04 and K-08, whose meshes pack into 1,135,111 and 1,065,550 static SD rows (18.2 and 17.1 MB), more than the firmware's 8 MB app partition. Every preset listed here is vendored under firmware/third_party/candela/content/presets and pinned by its PIN.json. fixedKernelSha256 is the SHA-256 of Candela's fixedText() (PRELUDE + SPECTRAL + ggxTableWGSL() + CORE + metalAt + hitAlbedo + hitEmission + PATH) that every scene's program must be compiled against (PICOCALC-CANDELA-WORLD design, Section 8).
